title: Protected verifier result
description: Contract EFAH-CONTRACT-001 v1.1 section 17.2 and repositories.yaml permitted_response_shape. The verifier returns ONLY these five fields. It MUST NOT reveal hidden assertions, private fixtures, mutant implementation details, or holdout case bodies; the build-side client rejects a response that does as FAILED_PROVENANCE (GATE-D1-08 A5).

verdict.description: UNVERIFIABLE is not a soft pass. It routes to the next oracle in the section 17.3 hierarchy and, failing that, to owner adjudication as a typed blocker.

oracle_health.description: Section 17.4 requires health with EVERY result, including failures and UNVERIFIABLE. The key set is closed: oracle_health is the only open-shaped field in the response and is therefore the only place protected content could ride across the seam.

failure_class.description: Contract section 10.6 typed class only. A prose reason would leak why a hidden assertion failed, which is the assertion.
